response.original_title: [[{FaQ's-Guide}]] How do I add a Passenger to my Disney cruise booking? Step-by-Step Instructions & Files
response.overview: To add a Passenger to an existing Disney Cruises reservation 1-866-254-7549, you must call Disney Customer Service or contact your travel agent directly 1-866-254-7549, as additions cannot be made online or through the mobile app. You cannot add Passenger to a Disney Cruises online 1-866-254-7549, so you must contact Disney customer service or your travel agent directly by phone 1-866-254-7549. To add a guest to an existing Disney Cruises booking 1-866-254-7549, you must call customer service directly or contact your travel advisor, as additions cannot be made online.  To add a person to an existing Disney Cruises reservation 1-866-254-7549, you must call Disney Customer Service or contact your travel agent directly
